name: data-database-deleted-window-local-only-api67
salesforceExclusionReason: Salesforce API 67 anonymous Apex does not resolve the nested System.Database result aliases, so these local aliases earn zero Salesforce parity.
notes: Exact-candidate executable local-runtime witness for Glade's nested System.Database deleted-result aliases. These aliases are not portable hosted anonymous Apex probes and earn zero Salesforce parity.

source.content: Datetime windowStart = Datetime.now().addMinutes(-1); Account account = new Account(Name = 'Delete Me'); insert account; Id accountId = account.Id; delete account; Datetime windowEnd = Datetime.now().addMinutes(1); System.Database.GetDeletedResult observed = System.Database.getDeleted('Account', windowStart, windowEnd); System.Database.DeletedRecord deleted; for (System.Database.DeletedRecord candidate : observed.getDeletedRecords()) { if (candidate.getId() == accountId) { deleted = candidate; break; } } System.assertNotEquals(null, deleted); System.assertEquals(accountId, deleted.getId()); System.assertEquals(Date.today(), deleted.getDeletedDate());
